claims.text: Many reviewers report the pens dry out quickly, sometimes within a week or even on arrival.
Several reviewers find the product easy to use and praise its natural-looking results.
Some reviewers say the black pen is too dark and looks unnatural, while the brown is more usable.
A few reviewers complain about application issues like leaking, blotchy lines, or lack of precision.
A couple of reviewers received defective or empty/used packages.
